notes: Added an idempotent Derke actor importer to the ADK loader.
If Derke already exists, his existing stats, inventory, cyberware, ownership, and other character data are preserved; the importer only repairs canonical identity and ADK scaffolding.
If Derke is missing, the loader creates a character actor using the canonical Derke identity, DK-02 roster code, current Forge portrait, linked 1x1 token art, and ADK playable flags.
Derke is placed under ADK Campaign PCs / OMEGA — Streetkids, creating those Actor folders if necessary.
The importer guarantees Derke has a Cyberware Cache without duplicating an existing cache.
The existing ADK roster and Entry Gateway already recognize Derke, so the imported actor becomes available to the ADK character selectors using the canonical derke roster key.
No unsupported Derke personality, combat stats, class build, gear, or cyberware were invented by this migration.
